title: Localization-compatible affine charts for an arbitrary-open integral map
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $j:U\hookrightarrow S$ be an arbitrary open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], and let $g:V\to U$ be an integral morphism [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. For every affine open $W=\operatorname{Spec}(A)\subseteq S$, after refining $W\cap U$ by a principal affine open cover $W_i=D(f_i)$ with $V_i=g^{-1}(W_i)=\operatorname{Spec}(B_i)$, the integral closures $C_i$ of $A$ in $B_i$ have canonical identifications after restricting to every affine overlap, induced by localization of integral closure. These identifications satisfy the cocycle condition, so the affine schemes $\operatorname{Spec}(C_i)$ glue compatibly as $W$ and the affine cover vary; the resulting glued scheme is integral over $S$ and restricts over $U$ to $V$.
